summary_en: Life Corporation launched a tender offer for all shares of Albis Co., Ltd. at 3,780 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 4,171,200 shares (49.9% of outstanding shares) and a 40-business-day offer period from September 9 to November 10, 2026, to take the company private. The board endorsed the offer and recommended shareholders to tender their shares.
title_en: Notice of Board Opinion Supporting Public Tender Offer for Shares of Albis Co., Ltd. by Life Corporation and Recommendation to Tender Shares
translation_en_brief:
On September 8, 2026, Albis Co., Ltd. announced that its board of directors has endorsed a tender offer by Life Corporation and recommended shareholders to tender their shares. The offer is pitched at 3,780 yen per share, with a minimum purchase target of 4,171,200 shares. This represents 49.9% of outstanding shares, calculated on the basis of 8,355,309 shares (total issued shares of 9,255,926 less treasury stock of 900,617 as of June 30, 2026). The tender offer period runs for 40 business days from September 9 through November 10, 2026.

The board's endorsement is premised on Life Corporation's intention to delist Albis and take it private following completion of the tender offer and subsequent corporate procedures. Mitsubishi Corporation, Albis's largest shareholder, has committed not to tender its shares. Upon completion of the minimum purchase target, Life Corporation's ownership would reach 66.62%, or 66.74% when including restricted stock awards held by directors and executive officers that cannot be tendered due to transfer restrictions. The board resolution was approved unanimously by all five participating directors, including three directors who hold restricted shares.
